Map of the countries, animated by year

Source: R/fct_plots.R
plot_map.Rd

The countries of countries() colored by the value of the indicator, from light for low to dark blue for high, on one scale for all the years.

Usage

plot_map(data, indicator)

Arguments

data

Data frame from get_indicator().

indicator

The id of the indicator in indicators(), for the title and the unit.

Value

A plotly object.

Examples

data <- data.frame(
  geo = rep(c("EL", "BG", "DE"), each = 2), country = rep(c("Greece", "Bulgaria", "Germany"), each = 2),
  group = "EU", year = rep(2023:2024, 3), value = c(11.1, 10.1, 4.3, 4.2, 3.0, 3.4)
)
plot_map(data, "unemployment")
